title: Vocabulary v0: skills
description: The reading skills (C2). The shape only: validate.py checks the references (every opportunity a demand id, every condition declared, names-off beside every guide-off of a full standard, a precision on every rhythm skill and on no untimed one) and app/tests/unit/vocabulary.test.ts checks the ids against concepts.json.

support.description: L57: the share of a skill's counted steps that must be right for a record to support it (the ladder's supporting, the transfer policy's full-standard support, the demand readings' below and held, the reader's held-back demands).

precision.description: L57 (reviewer decision 6): the error a timing skill is about, as [numerator, denominator] of a quarter-note beat; the evidence function's window must be narrower than it at the run's tempo.

support.description: The support share every skill reads unless it names its own.

precision.description: The precision a skill whose rhythm is the phrase's falls back to, where no rhythm demand is located at the step.

recordedBy.description: What records whether a run met it, or null where nothing does: a standard naming an unrecorded condition is one no run can be shown to meet, and the build gate refuses a rung that requires it.

newId.description: True where no concept id named the ability, so v0 added one (reviewer decision 2).

support.description: The skill's own support share, where its ability needs another than the vocabulary's (none does in v0).

precision.description: The skill's own precision: a rhythm skill's. Its demands are then the rhythm demands, which only timing can tell.

transfer.description: G2: the dimensions on which a change of material is transfer for this skill, each an entry of app/src/curriculum/transfer.ts DIMENSIONS (validate.py reads that list), and why. A skill without the block is credited no transfer, and the build lists it.
